I get it! phrase

also I understand, I see, now I get it, I get it all right, got it

classical

Traupman 99
Traupman 29

Jam teneō!

now I get it!

Examples

  • «Tū obrigado, quia puer es.» «Jam teneō!»

    “You say obrigado, because you’re a boy.” “Now I get it!”Libellus IV, Diēs Grātulātiōnis

  • Satis ea teneō.

    I get it all right.Traupman 99

  • Videō.

    I see.Traupman 62

See also do you get it?.

SourcesLewis & Short: teneo
